{{Top|leg}}
A '''vocorder''' was a piece of recording technology. [[Yosev Seville]] carried a vocorder in her [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit's]] leg pouch which she used to record her deal with the [[Sirdar]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] to eliminate the infestation of [[winged xendrite]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="CotG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
